events.name: ✨ Hidden Gem: St. Paul’s Chapel and the Historic Broadway Graveyard
events.description: Step inside Manhattan's oldest public building in continuous use, where George Washington prayed after his inauguration. While you can't see a Broadway musical here for free, the historic churchyard directly faces the modern Theater District's southern roots and offers a remarkably serene, history-rich escape from the bustling city. Afterward, stroll just a few blocks north to Porto Rico Importing Co. (established 1907) for an affordable, world-class bag of specialty roasted coffee, blending NYC's rich historical and culinary heritage.

schedule.insider_tip: To conquer the legendary Katz’s Deli like a true New Yorker, slip a dollar into your cutter’s tip jar right as you order—you'll score a piping-hot bonus sample of pastrami on the spot and ensure the absolute best cuts for your sandwich.
